headline: Open Meeting Law complaint, Flock Safety Program resolution, and Malden Police Department Q&A answers.
summary: The agenda covers an Open Meeting Law complaint and future improvements. It also reviews Malden Police Department Q&A answers and recaps a City Council resolution about the Flock Safety Program.
